Non-gating; does not touch the P5-N2 v1 result, the prereg, the chemistry set or any simulator prior.
scope: RF plasma sources (inductively coupled, helicon / B-assisted inductive, capacitive E-mode of ICPs) operated on N2, O2, O or air, as a pre-ionizer or ionization stage ahead of a Hall discharge, plus RF-based ABEP heritage documented in open sources. ECR/microwave sources are outside this lane.
abep_side: ABEP ionizer-inlet densities, pressures, temperatures, composition and flow come from the upstream ICD (intake -> filter -> compressor -> atmospheric gas chamber -> valve). None is defined yet: every ABEP-side value is TBD and no entry may claim regime_match 'yes' until the ICD exists.

conventions.doi_or_url: DOI of the published version when one exists, otherwise the URL accessed. accessed_version_url gives the copy actually read when it differs (arXiv, repository, preprint).
conventions.access: 'open' = full text read from a freely accessible copy; 'abstract_only' = only the abstract/metadata was read, the full text was not accessed.
conventions.evidence_class: docs/EVIDENCE.md quantity type of this number: measured (as reported by the experimenters, incl. reported setpoints/hardware specs and observed events), digitized, inferred (a ratio/bound/judgement computed from reported quantities, by the source or by us), reconstructed, model-derived (simulation/theory output), assumed (model input or design claim without validating evidence). null only for value_kind 'tbd'.
conventions.evidence_level: docs/EVIDENCE.md hierarchy relative to the question 'RF ionization stage for an ABEP Hall system': 3 = primary experimental report by the experimenters; 4 = evaluated data / validated physics; 5 = secondary or summary statement whose primary data cannot be inspected; 6 = model or correlation applied outside its validated domain (e.g. Xe-fitted closures reused for air); 7 = bare assumption. Hardware or gas dissimilarity is carried in applicability_to_abep, not in the level.
conventions.value: Preserved as reported, in the reported units. Ranges are {min, max}; one-sided bounds use only min or max. qualitative = verbatim or near-verbatim statement; tbd = the accessed source explicitly leaves it unmeasured/unstated.
conventions.conditions: Normalised to SI by unit conversion only (mT -> T, MHz -> Hz, mbar -> Pa, kW -> W). null = not stated in the source for that entry.
conventions.derived: Entries with a 'derived' block are computed by docs/evidence/rf_source/derive_rf_evidence.py from the listed entries (4 significant figures); assumed_inputs are declared with reasons.
